plugin.note: Lesser demons are demons, so demonbane weapons such as Emberlight or Arclight apply. They have low Defence and a 40% elemental weakness to water spells; most locations are single-combat, cannonable, and safespottable, so ranged or magic works well at cages and fences.

requirements: Combat level 60 is required to be assigned Lesser demons.
A slash weapon or knife is needed to reach the surface Lava Maze demons.
A shiny key and partial Temple of Ikov are needed for the Temple of Ikov demons.
Legends' Quest area access is needed for the Viyeldi caves demons.
mechanics: Lesser demons are demons, so demonbane weapons apply.
Lesser demons have a 40% elemental weakness to water spells.
Lesser demons attack with slash melee and are not aggressive to higher-level players.
Catacombs of Kourend lesser demons (levels 87 and 94) use the Catacombs drop table with ancient shards and dark totem pieces.
Wilderness Slayer Cave lesser demons (level 94, 110 Hitpoints) have enhanced drops but carry player killing risk.
Zakl'n Gritch in the God Wars Dungeon Zamorak stronghold counts as a Lesser demon kill with a different drop table.

methods.label: Chasm of Fire middle floor
methods.summary: Kill the 9 middle-floor lesser demons with demonbane melee or a cannon; four demons sit in one concentrated area.
steps: Take the Chasm of Fire to the middle floor.
Set up in the concentrated four-demon area.
Use demonbane melee or place a cannon in the single-combat area.
Demons here can drop contracts after speaking to Yama.

methods.label: Catacombs of Kourend
methods.summary: Kill the 8 Catacombs lesser demons for ancient shards and dark totem pieces in multicombat.
steps: Fight the level 87 and 94 lesser demons.
Collect ancient shards and dark totem pieces.

methods.label: Wilderness Slayer Cave (Krystilia)
methods.summary: Krystilia assignments are completed in the Wilderness; the Slayer Cave demons have enhanced drops but PK risk.
steps: Bring only what you are willing to lose.
Kill the 7 boosted lesser demons in the cave, or the Lava Maze / Demonic Ruins demons.
Keep an escape route ready (royal seed pod or 77 Agility shortcuts).
risks: Multicombat in the cave and at Demonic Ruins.
notes: Wilderness weapons gain their bonus here.

methods.label: Caged demon safespots
methods.summary: The Wizards' Tower, Kourend Castle, and Kingstown caged demons can be killed risk-free with ranged or magic.
requiredOrKeyItems: Ranged or magic weapon (or halberd at Kourend Castle)
steps: Attack with ranged, magic, or a halberd.
Bank nearby at Kourend Castle if needed.
notes: Only one spawn per cage, so these are slow for full tasks.

styleOptions.label: Melee demonbane
styleOptions.summary: Demonbane melee is the standard method against their low Defence.

styleOptions.label: Ranged safespot or cannon
styleOptions.summary: Ranged works at cages and fences, and cannons apply at most locations.

styleOptions.label: Water spells
styleOptions.summary: Water spells exploit the 40% elemental weakness when safespotting.
